# gtm_built_in_variable (Resource)

Manages a Google Tag Manager BuiltInVariable object through API v2.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent` (String) Canonical API-relative path of the parent resource.
- `type` (String) Type of built-in variable.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the built-in variable to be used to refer to the built-in variable.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) GTM Account ID.
- `container_id` (String) GTM Container ID.
- `id` (String) Canonical API-relative resource path.
- `path` (String) Canonical API-relative resource path.
- `workspace_id` (String) GTM Workspace ID.
